description: Fills the FTP/SFTP credentials stored in Bitwarden into sftp.json, so they never sit in plain text in your project.
command.lock: Lock and remove credentials from sftp.json
config.cliPath: Path to the Bitwarden CLI executable (`bw`).
config.templateFile: Template file (relative to the workspace folder) containing `{{bw:...}}` references. This file can be committed.
config.outputFile: Generated file read by the SFTP extension.
config.autoLockMinutes: Minutes after which credentials are removed from `sftp.json` automatically (`0` = never, only when VS Code closes).
config.cleanupMode: What to do with `sftp.json` when locking.
config.cleanupMode.strip: Rewrite sftp.json keeping non-secret settings and removing the values taken from Bitwarden.
config.rememberSession: Keep the Bitwarden session in the OS keychain (VS Code SecretStorage), so the master password is not asked at every start.
